method: Same logged avoided-read size, observed successful client-request note presence, note text charged on every appearance; no learning costs.
assumptions: Confirmed does not prove reading avoided.
Hypothetical code results initially share note lifetime; stop-at-new-clear is a sensitivity scenario.
Quarter-read is a sensitivity assumption, not a measured reduction.
Rendered text characters / 3.6; shared hook wrapper and unrelated notes excluded.
Repeated copies cost input, but avoided reads credited only once per request per note.
Only successful main-thread Claude requests with snapshots are covered.
Unresolved message bodies are not guessed. Counts cover positively observed rendered note payloads; unknown bodies can contain additional note text.
